Place the order this week to account for the six-week lead time and avoid stock shortages as experienced last year.

Description: Schedule and prepare for the next team check-in in two weeks (same time). By that checkpoint, the venue contract should be signed and the full speaker lineup should be locked. Track progress on all action items and bring status updates to the meeting.
